brand.name: HSE Doc Studio
brand.tagline: A workshop for HSE coursework and theses: templates, PDF builds, compliance checks and checkpoint submissions.

folder.title: Where to keep your work
folder.subtitle: Pick a folder on your computer — it will hold your projects, settings and fonts. Nothing else needs configuring.
folder.relativeWarning: An absolute path is required. Docker reads a relative one as a volume name and mounts an empty directory.
folder.readOnly: This folder is not writable — pick another one or create a new one inside your home folder.

hint.windows: A full path with a drive letter, e.g. C:/Users/ivan/hse-doc-studio. Forward and back slashes both work.
hint.macos: A full path from the root, e.g. /Users/ivan/hse-doc-studio.
hint.linux: A full path from the root, e.g. /home/ivan/hse-doc-studio.

folder.previousInstall: This is a previous HSE Doc Studio data folder: projects and settings will be picked up, nothing gets erased.

missing.title: No such folder
missing.hint: Check the spelling, or go back and pick one from the list. You can also create it here with the button below.

not_shared.title: Docker cannot reach this drive
not_shared.hint: Add it under Docker Desktop → Settings → Resources → File sharing.

permission.title: No permission for this drive
permission.hint: Docker cannot read it. Pick a folder inside your home directory.

mount_rejected.title: Docker refused to open this folder
mount_rejected.hint: Check the path: it must be absolute and point at an existing drive.

docker_unavailable.title: Docker is not responding
docker_unavailable.hint: While it is unavailable the folder contents cannot be listed.

timeout.title: The check timed out
timeout.hint: Docker did not answer. Please try again.

unknown.title: Could not look inside the folder
unknown.hint: Nothing is known about this folder, so it cannot be chosen.

noSubfolders.title: No subfolders here
noSubfolders.hint: You can use this folder as is, or create a new one inside it.

noMatches.title: Nothing matches “{{query}}”
noMatches.hint: The filter only looks inside this folder. Go up a level or clear it.

filesOnly.title: Only files matched
filesOnly.hint: No folders here carry that name. Only a folder can be chosen.

machine.coresHint: CPU cores available to containers — this is what document builds run on.
machine.memoryHint: Memory available to containers. On Docker Desktop this is the virtual machine's quota, not the whole computer.
machine.freeHint: Free space on the disk holding the chosen folder.
machine.lowDiskHint: Running low. The first build pulls the TeX Live image — several gigabytes.
machine.fontsHint: This is where the app will take Times New Roman and the other document fonts from.
machine.fontsMissingHint: None of the standard locations matched. Enter the path if your fonts live elsewhere.
machine.texPrefetch: Download right after setup — the first build won't have to wait

restarting.title: Setting the app up
restarting.hint: This usually takes under a minute. No need to refresh — the page will do it itself.

steps.recreating: Recreating the app with this folder
steps.waiting: Waiting for it to come back

cli_missing.title: Docker unavailable
cli_missing.hint: The Docker socket is not mounted into the container — the app cannot configure itself.

socket_permission.title: No access to the Docker socket
socket_permission.hint: The process lacks permission on /var/run/docker.sock. It needs to be started with --group-add.

daemon_unreachable.title: Docker is not running
daemon_unreachable.hint: Start Docker Desktop and press “Check again”.

timeout.title: Docker is not responding
timeout.hint: The daemon did not answer in time.

compose.title: This install is managed by docker compose ({{project}})
compose.hint: The wizard will not fix it for you: the next “docker compose up -d” would bring the old configuration back. Put the folder into the .env next to docker-compose.yml and bring the stack up again.

manual.title: Run it manually
manual.hint: Stop the current container and run this command — your folder is already filled in.

error.not_absolute: An absolute path is required: Docker reads a relative one as a volume name and mounts an empty directory.
error.recreate_failed: Could not start the recreation. Check that the Docker socket is mounted into the container.
error.restart_timeout: The app did not come back in time. It rolled back to the previous configuration — check the hse-studio-updater container log.
error.request_failed: The server did not respond. Please try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
